body:
Clear Vision brings together a hand-fired cloisonné bead with Lapis Lazuli and Tanzanite, a pairing built around clarity and intuition. Each cloisonné bead is shaped using an ancient enameling technique, hand-formed one partition of color at a time, making every bead its own small piece of craftsmanship.

Lapis Lazuli has been prized for centuries, historically associated with wisdom, truth, and inner sight. It's often reached for during moments that call for honesty, both with others and with yourself. Tanzanite carries a more expansive, higher-vibration association, often linked to opening deeper awareness and intuition beyond the surface level.

Clear Vision is meant for the moments when there's too much noise: too many opinions, too many options, too much second-guessing. Instead of adding more information, this pairing is designed to support quieting down and listening to what you already know. The cloisonné bead's hand-crafted detail is a visual reminder to slow down, while the stones carry the energetic intention to see clearly.

This bracelet stands well on its own or stacked with the rest of the Painted Intentions collection. It pairs naturally with Open Love for moments that call for both clarity and self-compassion.
